//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Shulker Drops Two -> Config

Enable Shulker Drops Two.//: Whether Shulker Drops Two is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

alwaysDropShells.//: Ignore the drop chance (default 50%) that a Shulker will drop their shell and instead makes them always drop it.

shulkerDropAmount.//: Sets the amount of shells Shulkers drop. min: 1, max: 64
